metadata.title: In Paradise, dozens rode out the Camp Fire
metadata.author: Reporter Name

text: ARTICLE-KMART. As the Camp Fire swept through Paradise on Nov. 8, Joe Kennedy said he and about 50 others sheltered in the Kmart parking lot on Clark Road. Mrs. Lopez drove to Lake Concow and waited in the water. Others were evacuated to the Sacramento Convention Center days later.

metadata.title: How a Walgreens lot became a lifeboat

text: ARTICLE-WALGREENS. Nurses and patients waited out the flames in the Walgreens parking lot on Clark Road, said Maria Gonzalez, a nurse.
